title: Meaning, facts, permission and execution stay separate
summary: Management discovers what specialists can answer. Domain objects own facts, Intention providers own meaning, policy owns permission, and domain adapters own execution syntax. Recognition never implies authority.
invariants: LLM or deterministic intention recognition supplies meaning, not operational authority.
Instrumentation and observations are evidence, never mutation authority.
Mutation must continue through the normal Intention Service confirmation/READY/COMMIT and domain policy path.
Management owns no provider credentials, cloud CLI syntax, raw network probing, host shell or transport acquisition.
cloudctl.sh and sshnode.sh are convenience/qualification/emergency shortcuts only; they are not semantic APIs or capability registries.
Native controls are implementation details; authoritative Alchemy/domain objects are the public system.
ALCHEMY_CLOUD_CONTROL / alchemy.cloud-control/0.1 owns cloud RESOURCE/NODE mutation authority; Management and Cloud Console do not become cloud capability truth.
ooRexx Cloud Console owns caller-facing vocabulary, PLAN/APPLY fencing and rendering; its provider-native read path is observation evidence, not mutation authority.
Generic firewall source reconciliation changes only the requested scoped rule; the caller/domain authority owns the desired source set and unrelated rules remain untouched.

provenance.claim: Architecture guard rejects cloud/provider shortcut execution knowledge from Management source/tests.
Read-only instrumentation intention surface deliberately excludes Instrumentation Mesh command envelopes.
Qualified five-provider RESOURCE transport with fail-closed scoped firewall source-set reconciliation; no live-provider mutation acceptance claimed.
Qualified human/code/Codex facade and Cloud Control mutation backend under exact ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196, including cross-package integration.
